# Third-party art used in Farroad

These files are NOT in the repo (their licences forbid redistribution, and
this repo is public). They are listed in .gitignore and must be copied in
locally from the original download before building.

| Used as | Source | Licence summary |
|---|---|---|
| Ansa (test, retired 2026-09-26 -- units now use the male/female MC sets; local copy kept in `art_src/third_party/otsoga_godot/`, no longer in builds): Joanna idle 1-6 | "Free Medieval NPC's: Witch And Swordswoman" by Otsoga, https://otsoga.itch.io/free-medieval-npcs-witch-and-swordswoman | Personal + commercial use, modification allowed, credit appreciated (not required), NO redistribution or resale |
